item.title: SWEET SMOKE SOUNDS
item.description: Sweet Smoke is a curated sound session, live recorded with hosts DJ FRECKLES and Arthur Bray alongside new selections of records, art books & zines selected by the duo.

item.title: Cheaper Than Therapy – A Shelf-Index Community Service Order
item.description: “Cheaper than Therapy”, a monthly sonic presentation hosted by Dom aka @shelfindex on @FMBELOWGROUND

item.title: SLIMEFEST
item.description: From outdoor raves to indoor trenches, new runners in town Slimefest jump into the studio for a series of b2bs that blend techno, electro & ‘90s breaks, displaying their take on Hong Kong’s underground dance scene.

item.title: THE CFK SHOW
item.description: CFK Productions | Broadcasting & media production company Document pop & underground culture + produce CFK Radio & The CFK Show on FM Belowground.

item.title: yonders
item.description: presented by DJ-ÖRK, 'yonders' is a sonic exploration showcasing DJs from Vietnam and its diaspora, as they interpret club music from an at-home perspective and beyond. invited guest are encouraged to play what they usually don't get to play at clubs, current obsessions, Vietnamese music (from pop to experimental), and anything in between. DJ-ÖRK will then try to 'open' or 'close' the mix accordingly, making each show a 90-minute collaborative experience with acts and chapters.

item.title: can i spin 4 u?
item.description: “can I spin 4 u?” – a genre-bending experience heavy on polyrhythms and thumping basslines. From Afro Electronica to Breakbeat, Footwork, House, Experimental and beyond, KATAGYAL celebrates Black music in all its forms. Tune in every 3rd Wednesday of the month for a 60 minute delight.

item.title: “Music for your Mind, Body & Soul”w/ Roy Malig aka ViBAHoLICS
item.description: Roy Malig aka ViBAHoLICS presents “Music for your Mind, Body & Soul.” Sounds from the veteran DJ who was a fundamental force during the height of vinyl running the record shop Trendza in Hong Kong.

item.title: REZONATE
item.description: REZONATE is Hong Kong dance/rave collective comprise of various members that prefer the odd hours over prime time. Frequenting haunts like Mihn, Oma and Social Room. The collective are stewards of forward-thinking electronica.
